convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load a custom indicator 'TSI_CCI' which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. Also depends on two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh and SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trade execution and smoothing algorithms. The custom indicator logic and library functions must be manually reimplemented in Python.

custom_logic_notes: The TSI_CCI custom indicator is a True Strength Index applied to CCI, using configurable smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA via SmoothAlgorithms.mqh). The crossover logic uses a two-bar comparison: previous bar (index 1) determines trend direction, and the bar at SignalBar offset (default 1, so current-1) detects the actual crossover moment (Ind[0]<=Sign[0] for bullish crossover confirmation). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose wrappers and the CIsNewBar class. LoadHistory() call ensures bar data availability. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans allow independently enabling/disabling each trade direction and close-on-reversal.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement: (1) TSI_CCI indicator - triple-smoothed CCI momentum with configurable smoothing (EMA default, supports JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA), (2) TradeAlgorithms position sizing logic for 5 MarginMode variants, (3) CIsNewBar new-bar detection. The core signal logic is straightforward: Ind vs Sign crossover. Start with EMA-only smoothing (MODE_EMA=1) which maps directly to pandas EWM. The GetStartBars function from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh determines warmup periods per smoothing method. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from the previous completed bar (standard for backtesting). Entry: long when Ind crosses above Sign; short when Ind crosses below Sign. Exit: opposite signal closes position. SL=1000 points, TP=2000 points. Position sizing default is LOT (fixed lot), fraction MM=0.1.
